lenders.name: Agricultural Finance Corporation (AFC)
lenders.collateral: title deed, livestock, or crop insurance
lenders.notes: Government lender. Fixed 10% p.a. Cheapest formal option. Free hotline.
lenders.sms_blurb: AFC: 10% per YEAR (not month). Dial *234# or call 0800 723 573 FREE.

lenders.name: Safaricom DigiFarm
lenders.notes: Loan in seeds/fertilizer not cash. Repay after harvest. Works on feature phone.
lenders.sms_blurb: DigiFarm: inputs loan, no collateral, repay at harvest. Dial *944# now.

lenders.name: Hustler Fund
lenders.notes: 8% p.a. No collateral. Apply via M-Pesa. Up to KSh 200,000.
lenders.sms_blurb: Hustler Fund: 8% per YEAR. Up to KSh 200,000. Apply via M-Pesa menu. No collateral.

lenders.name: KCB Mkulima Loan
lenders.notes: 12% p.a. Insurance bundled. Up to KSh 5M. Needs active KCB account.
lenders.sms_blurb: KCB Mkulima: 12% per YEAR. Up to KSh 5M. Call 0711 087 000. Need KCB account.

lenders.name: M-Shwari (Safaricom + NCBA)
lenders.notes: 7.5% one-time fee per 30-day loan = ~90% APR. ONLY for genuine emergencies under KSh 50K.
lenders.sms_blurb: M-Shwari: 7.5% fee (90% APR). Max KSh 50K, 30 days only. Emergency use only. Via M-Pesa.

lenders.name: Juhudi Kilimo
lenders.notes: Asset financing for farmers without title deeds. Group guarantee model.
lenders.sms_blurb: Juhudi Kilimo: no title deed needed. Group guarantee. Call 0722 207 305.

lenders.name: Kenya Women Finance Trust (KWFT)
lenders.notes: Women farmers only. Group lending. No land collateral needed. Free hotline.
lenders.sms_blurb: KWFT (women only): group lending, no land needed. Call 0800 720 536 FREE.

lenders.name: Pezesha
lenders.notes: Targets rural informal borrowers. Uses Patascore credit scoring.
lenders.sms_blurb: Pezesha: no collateral, no credit history needed. Rural agents. Apply via SMS/USSD.
